summary: Connect Dailybot to the AI assistant you already use, including Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and VS Code, and ask about check-ins, blockers, and forms in plain words. It works on free plans, with setup videos and 12 ready-made Claude apps.
body_markdown:
Dailybot MCP is here. If you already live in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or another assistant, you can now connect Dailybot to it and ask about your team without opening another tab. It works on free plans, and setup takes about a minute.


## Dailybot MCP: your team inside your AI assistant


MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the standard way AI assistants plug into other apps. Add the Dailybot connector once and your assistant can read what your team shares in Dailybot: check-ins, forms, and kudos. Ask “Who’s blocked this week?” or “What needs me today?” and it answers from your real team data.


It works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, and any client that supports remote MCP over HTTPS. Every client uses the same URL,` https://mcp.dailybot.com/mcp` , and signs in through your browser. You choose one organization and approve the connection, and the assistant sees only what your own Dailybot account can see. Remove the connector and access ends.


Reading is instant. Changes wait for your request: your assistant can fill in a check-in, set a reminder, give kudos, or ask a teammate a quick question, and you can review the action before it runs. A write never goes to a guessed person or team, a retry doesn’t send or create twice, and the links an assistant shares point to the real Dailybot screens. Your notes, reports, and kudos stay yours.


Connecting and asking work on the free plans of Dailybot, Claude, and ChatGPT. In ChatGPT, OpenAI makes actions that change things, like sending or approving, available on its Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans, where an admin decides who can add custom plugins. If your assistant says MCP isn’t enabled for your organization, ask your Dailybot admin to check it.


Two short videos show the setup in Claude and in ChatGPT. Coding tools take one command, for example in Claude Code:


```text
claude   mcp   add   --transport   http   dailybot   https://mcp.dailybot.com/mcp
```


The[MCP quickstart](https://www.dailybot.com/mcp/quickstart) has the steps for every client, written for people who aren’t technical and for people who are. The[developer guide](https://www.dailybot.com/developers/mcp) covers configuration and troubleshooting. If a coding agent sets the client up for you, hand it the guide and complete the browser sign-in yourself.


## Twelve Claude apps, ready to duplicate


Once the connector is in Claude, you can skip the blank page. We built[12 ready-made Claude apps](https://www.dailybot.com/mcp/templates) that run on your Dailybot: Morning Co-pilot for your priorities and check-in, Stand-up Sync to answer your check-in, Team Pulse to see who answered and who is blocked, Approvals Inbox, 1:1 Prep, Kudos Finder, Form Digest, and more. Open a template, duplicate it, and it works with your team’s data.
